subject: Allocating cross-entity refunds and fee offsets
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@novotix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novotix Finance <finance@novotix.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Refund & fee-offset across entities for Q3 adjustments

Hi Ben,

Following up from our billing review: we identified a set of invoice credits and transaction fee reversals that need to be applied across three Novotix legal entities (Novotix US, Novotix EU, Novotix LatAm) for Q3. The credits are twofold:

- Seat credits issued for over-provisioning (customer-initiated downsizing)
- Stripe processing fee reversals where payments were refunded to customers

We need Redwood to: 1) split the net refund amounts to the correct legal entities, 2) apply offsets against outstanding fees where appropriate, and 3) provide a VAT-friendly breakdown for our EU entity (we are VAT-registered).

I attached a short summary and a CSV of the affected invoice IDs. Can Redwood propose how you will record the ledger entries so our AP team can reconcile? Also please confirm whether Redwood can issue combined credits on a single cover invoice or whether we need separate entity-level credit memos.

Thanks,
Lydia
Lydia Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Novotix

Attachments: novotix_refund_request.pdf (summary), invoice_list_q3.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@novotix.com>
Cc: Novotix Finance <finance@novotix.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Refund & fee-offset across entities for Q3 adjustments

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear summary and the CSV. We can absolutely handle this; below is a proposed approach so your AP team can preview the output. Please confirm if this aligns with Novotix accounting practices.

High-level proposal:
- Create entity-level credit memos for each legal entity (Novotix US / EU / LatAm) that reflect the portion of seat credits attributable to that entity.
- Apply fee reversals as a separate negative line item on the corresponding entity memo where the original payment was captured. If a refunded payment spanned multiple entities, we’ll allocate proportionally based on the original invoice allocation.
- Generate a consolidated reconciliation CSV that maps original invoice IDs -> credit memo IDs -> GL account mappings (we’ll include VAT breakdown where applicable).

Options for delivery:
1) Separate entity-level credit memos (recommended for clean ledgers and VAT compliance).
2) One consolidated cover invoice with attached per-entity breakout (possible but requires manual entry on your end to update entity books).

Next steps for us:
- We’ll prepare a draft refund allocation matrix and a sample credit memo for Novotix US for your review.
- Marissa / Priya, can you confirm whether we should route EU VAT lines to GL 2204-VAT and whether the LatAm refunds need local tax withholding treatment?

I’ve attached a first-pass workbook (proposed_refund_matrix_v1.xlsx) that shows the suggested splits.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_refund_matrix_v1.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia@novotix.com>, Novotix Finance <finance@novotix.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Refund & fee-offset across entities for Q3 adjustments

Marissa / Priya — forwarding Novotix's ask. I prepared a draft allocation in the attached workbook. Key questions:

- VAT: For EU lines, we plan to present net refunds and an explicit VAT reclaimable amount (Novotix is VAT-registered). Priya, can Legal/Tax confirm approach?
- GL mapping: Marissa, to ensure clean month-end close, do we map the seat-credit contra revenues to GL 4101-CustomerCredits or a separate cost-center clearing GL?
- Fee offsets: If Stripe processed refunds after the fact, Stripe will issue fee reversals to us; do we route those fee reversals back to the same entity that recorded the original payment?

Requesting a quick thumbs-up or call — Lydia is hoping for this to be processed in the Nov 15 run.

Thanks — Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Park <lydia@novotix.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Refund & fee-offset across entities for Q3 adjustments

Ben / Priya — quick takes:

- Map seat-credit adjustments to 4101-CustomerCredits (that keeps revenue intact and makes the audit trail explicit).
- For EU VAT: present VAT as a separate line on the credit memo (VAT reclaimable). Priya, we will need the VAT registration number on each invoice mapping row.
- Stripe fee reversals: yes, route back to the entity that recognized the original payment; if the original payment was consolidated in Stripe and split later, use the proportional allocation method Ben proposed.

I can approve the proposed matrix as-is once the VAT columns are populated and the GL mappings are confirmed per-line. Marissa

Marissa Cole
Director, Accounting Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lydia Park <lydia@novotix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Novotix Finance <finance@novotix.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Refund & fee-offset across entities for Q3 adjustments

Ben / Marissa / Priya — this approach works for Novotix. We prefer separate entity-level credit memos (option 1). I attached the VAT registration numbers and a short mapping file to the drive link.

Two additional asks:
1) Can Redwood include a note on each credit memo referencing the original customer-facing invoice ID? That will speed our reconciliation.
2) Can you confirm whether Redwood will post the Stripe fee reversals to our account or whether Stripe will issue the reverse-fee to Novotix directly (we need to know the cashflow path).

If you can deliver the finalized matrix and sample credit memos by Tues Nov 9 EOD, we’ll queue them for the Nov 15 run.

Thanks — Lydia

Attachments mentioned: VAT_numbers_novotix.pdf (on Drive), mapping_note.txt
